title: Afternoon Stop Release Rules for Young Riders: Student Transportation Services
content:
**Rule.** A Student Transportation Services rider in a grade on the type's list of grades released only to an adult is released at the PM stop only to a parent or an authorized adult on file. When no one is there, the student is returned to the campus and the family picks the student up there. Each return is recorded once per service date. When the returns in one semester reach the return limit (3 for every type), riding is suspended for the no-adult suspension days (3 school days for every type), starting the next school day. A return does not count as a conduct offense and never revokes a courtesy permit.

The returns counted are those on the assignment in the semester of the service date.

## Count, both sides (hypothetical, limit 3)

| Returns recorded this semester, the new one included | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 or 2 | the student is returned to campus; no suspension |
| 3 | riding is suspended for 3 school days from the next school day |

## Points of judgement

- **Two returns on one day.** One return is recorded for that service date.
- **A second grader on a courtesy permit returned three times in the fall (hypothetical).** Riding is suspended for 3 school days; the permit is not revoked and the returns do not add to the conduct offense count.
- **A fourth grader on Regular Route Eligibility.** Grade 04 is not on the list for that type, so the student is released at the PM stop. On Special Education Transportation the list runs PK3 through 12, so the same student is released only to an adult.
